name: memory_multi_evidence_recall
description: Recalls contradictory and evolving facts about an entity or query, returning competing hypothesis clusters, epistemic confidence spread, and recommended action policies (ACCEPT_WINNER, PRESENT_ALTERNATIVES, ASK_CLARIFYING_QUESTION, ABSTAIN).

query.description: Natural language query or topic to evaluate.

subject.description: Specific subject entity name to check for bitemporal conflicts.

top_k.description: Number of memory evidence items to return (1-20).

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
